scope: G5 real-wallet guard observations supplied through user screenshots while scanning DemoMintPauseToken; operational evidence, not a canonical analyzer report

displayedReport.basis: transcribed from user screenshot; this report body and snapshot have not been independently validated

unauthorizedAccount.basis: user-provided screenshot; MetaMask shows Account 2 connected to localhost on Fuji

accountChangeEvent.message: Wallet changed. Check the account and network again.

accountChangeReadinessInvalidation.basis: The user explicitly confirmed that Check wallet had enabled Publish before switching accounts; the after-change screenshot shows Wallet changed and Publish disabled.
accountChangeReadinessInvalidation.userConfirmationVietnamese: Đã thấy Publish bật trước khi đổi tài khoản
accountChangeReadinessInvalidation.provenanceNote: The supplied earlier screenshot predates the intervening successful Check wallet. The enabled state is user-confirmed in text; the changed-account disabled state is visible in the screenshot.

reportChangeReadinessInvalidation.basis: Before/after user screenshots supplied in response to the guided rescan check show the same Account 1 on Fuji, initially authorized with Publish enabled, then the initial wallet-check prompt with Publish disabled.
reportChangeReadinessInvalidation.afterMessage: Connect the attester wallet on Avalanche Fuji (43113) to check permission.
reportChangeReadinessInvalidation.provenanceNote: The new report snapshot is not visible in these screenshots. The earlier displayedReport snapshot must not be assumed to identify the rescan.

intentionalRejectRecovery.basis: The user explicitly confirmed Cancel during Publish; the after-cancel screenshot shows the recoverable wallet error, Check wallet enabled and Publish disabled, without a displayed transaction hash or success state.
intentionalRejectRecovery.userConfirmationVietnamese: Đây nhé, tôi đã bấm cancel lúc publish
intentionalRejectRecovery.message: Wallet rejected or failed to submit the transaction.
intentionalRejectRecovery.provenanceNote: This records cancellation handling and availability of a fresh wallet check. A subsequent successful Mint/pause publication is independently verified in the linked publication evidence; the canceled prompt itself has no displayed transaction hash.

publicationForThisTarget: subsequent successful publication independently verified; see g5-mintpause-publication-2026-11-18.json
attachmentNote: Names refer to chat screenshots; image files are not included in the release bundle.
assistantActions: Local evidence/documentation only; no account or network changes, signing, broadcast, commit/push or hosting action
